title: The Silo Problem
lines: SaaS has siloed our data for decades.
This was a consequence of cloud software economics.
But today apps are easier to build, and agents need all of our data to be useful.
That demands a new data and security model.
text: SaaS has siloed our data for decades. This was a consequence of cloud software economics. But today apps are easier to build, and agents need all of our data to be useful. That demands a new data and security model.

title: Monolithic Agents
lines: Today we grant agents coarse-grained access to everything, with no audit and limited control.
This approach is risky, and it simply doesn't work for agents that run continuously with evolving requirements.
text: Today we grant agents coarse-grained access to everything, with no audit and limited control. This approach is risky, and it simply doesn't work for agents that run continuously with evolving requirements.

title: ECHO Graph Database
lines: The ECHO Database takes a fundamentally different approach.
Enterprise, team, and personal data connect into a unified virtual semantic graph.
Composer brings it all together in one super app, replacing dozens of separate SaaS tools.
text: The ECHO Database takes a fundamentally different approach. Enterprise, team, and personal data connect into a unified virtual semantic graph. Composer brings it all together in one super app, replacing dozens of separate SaaS tools.

title: ECHO Hypergraph
lines: The graph is partitioned into interconnected workspaces;
enabling teams and agents to work within a secure shared context.
Workspaces adapt to the work, drawing in data from different sources as the projects and tasks evolve.
text: The graph is partitioned into interconnected workspaces; enabling teams and agents to work within a secure shared context. Workspaces adapt to the work, drawing in data from different sources as the projects and tasks evolve.

title: Open and Extensible
lines: Open by design, it lets teams and third parties extend it -- building with their own apps, plugins and agents.
And the entire stack runs on Cloudflare Workers, so they are secure, cost-effective, and scale on demand.
DXOS is the operating system for the new enterprise.
